id: \rI'm sorry, but only the royal family is allowed in here.
en: \rI'm sorry, but only the royal family is allowed in here.
it: \rMi dispiace, ma qui può entrare solo la famiglia reale.

id: \rAren't these Togepi just beautiful? I actually just released my Togetic so it could stay here with them.
en: \rAren't these Togepi just beautiful? I actually just released my Togetic so it could stay here with them.
it: \rNon sono bellissimi questi Togepi? Ho appena liberato il mio Togetic perché potesse restare qui con loro.

id: \rA battle might take my mind off it. What do you say?
en: \rA battle might take my mind off it. What do you say?
it: \rUna lotta potrebbe distrarmi un po'. Che ne dici?

id: \rThis is the Mirage Kingdom. We are a small group that worship the Togepi family.
en: \rThis is the Mirage Kingdom. We are a small group that worship the Togepi family.
it: \rQuesto è il Regno Miraggio. Siamo un piccolo gruppo che venera la famiglia dei Togepi.

id: \bWe don't let many people do this but your Pokémon seem to care a lot for you.
en: \bWe don't let many people do this but your Pokémon seem to care a lot for you.
it: \bNon lo permettiamo a molte persone, ma i tuoi Pokémon sembrano tenere molto a te.

id: \bBe sure to raise it with lots of love.
en: \bBe sure to raise it with lots of love.

id: \rDon't you just love how peaceful they are?
en: \rDon't you just love how peaceful they are?

id: \bThe king and queen live in the palace up there.
en: \bThe king and queen live in the palace up there.
it: \bIl re e la regina vivono nel palazzo lassù.
